usedFor: Shopify holds paid orders, and Whautomate keeps each buyer as a client, tagged with “Assign Tags to Client”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create Client” in Whautomate
bestTemplate.why: A paid order is a confirmed buyer, so they become a client in the messaging tool.

watchOut: “Assign Tags to Client” works on an existing client, so run “Create Client” before it.
